[PR #314](https://github.com/toddwyder/julia-next/pull/314) is ready against `main`, unmerged. Decision-log row pushed in `eacf19e`.

CI is **failing**: Windows checks report missing `@mastra/code-sdk` and `verify-machine/generation.json`. Baseline, docs policy and Vercel passed.

JUL-251 follow-up on hybrid/pstack-trial (PR #314). Do not merge. Spending stays $0. Where a part below is already done, verify it and keep it.

1. CI fix. Claude's technical decision under Todd's 09:52 rule: builds run on the server, so the Windows laptop-runner CI gate is retired. Use the correct skill on this mistake class: tests fail in CI because a hand-kept inclusion/exclusion list decides where they run, and a skill's test lives outside its skill.
   - Retire the Windows runner gate in CI.
   - Each test runs where its owner's dependencies are installed, decided by structure (owning package and lockfile), never by a hand-kept list. A new test lands in the right place with no list edit.
   - Tests that need the server's keys or a live provider run on the server, also decided by structure.
   - A skill's tests live inside that skill's folder, so removing a skill removes its tests. Delete the orphaned verify-machine test.
   Prove it: replay the two tests that broke PR #314's first CI run and show they now land correctly.

2. Maintenance on merge. Todd's decision, 22 October 2026 20:06 PT: verification skills are maintained on every merge to main. Build it as structure, not a rule an agent must remember: when main gains a merge, the server automatically starts a fresh Codex session that runs the maintain-verification-skill skill on each project verification skill (today: verify-julia). Use the skill's own outcomes: clean (nothing to do), changed (one PR of proven corrections, confined to the skill's folder), blocked (one line to Todd). It never edits product code. Prove it: a test merge to a throwaway branch standing in for main triggers exactly one maintenance run, and no merge triggers none.

Record decisions in the JUL-251 decision log and push.

Done when: PR #314's CI is green on the fixed head and both proofs are pushed.

Report: what structure now decides where each test runs, what triggers maintenance and where it runs, the CI result, and both proof results.

[PR #314](https://github.com/toddwyder/julia-next/pull/314) is **CI green at `a22a340`**, open and unmerged. Spending stayed $0.

- **Test structure:** the nearest package and lockfile own dependencies. `server` folders route key/live-provider tests to ubuntu. Browser runtimes follow declared dependencies. Skill tests live inside their skill; the Windows gate is retired.
- **Maintenance:** an enabled server timer detects new main merges and starts one fresh Codex session to maintain discovered verification skills, currently `verify-julia`. Product files are read-only.
- **CI proof:** the SDK regression passes under its owning install; the orphaned test is deleted and absent from discovery.
- **Merge proof:** a real throwaway merge launched exactly one session and completed clean against a CLI fixture. No merge, direct commit and repeated polls launched none.

Both proofs and decisions are pushed in the [follow-up report](https://github.com/toddwyder/julia-next/blob/a22a340/docs/agents/jul-251/follow-up-report.md).
